newsitem.title: USA: Jefferson to buyback shrs, projects Q3 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Jefferson to buyback shrs, projects Q3 EPS.

text.p: Jefferson Bankshares Inc said Thursday that it had authorized the repurchase of up to 1.25 million shares, adding that the cost of the buyback would range from $31.3 to $35 million.
In a release Thursday, Jefferson said it expects net income for the third quarter ending September 30, 1996 to be between $7 and $7.3 million and net income per share to be between $0.46 and $0.48.
Analysts' consensus estimate for Jefferson's third quarter is $0.47 a share, according to First Call.
Under the terms of the buyback, Jefferson shareholders have the opportunity to sell part or all of their shares at a price between $25 and $28 a share, the company said.
The repurchase of 1.25 million common shares represents 8.3 percent of its 15.1 million shares outstanding, Jefferson said.
Jefferson added that the offer expires on October 31, 1996 unless extended by the company.
